s_dash
On your TAG Markets dashboard, tap upload documents.
s_cont
You opened it from TAG Markets, so tap Continue.
s_country
Confirm your country of residence, then tap Agree and continue.
s_email
Under Get verified faster with Sumsub I D, enter the same email you've used from the start, and tap Start verification.
s_code
Sumsub emails you a six digit code. Type it in, and never share this code with anyone.
s_save
Read the consent, tick the box, and tap Create my account.
s_created
Your Sumsub I D account is created. Tap Continue verification.
s_doc
Choose your issuing country and your document. I chose Identity Card.
s_double
If your card has two sides, tick My document is double-sided, then tap Continue.
s_ready
Read the tips: a well lit room, no reflections, and never edit the images. Tap Continue.
s_allow
When your browser asks to use the camera, tap Allow.
s_bubble
It says this site can't ask for your permission? Close screen recorders and chat bubbles, like WhatsApp, then tap Try again.
s_scan
Hold your I D card inside the frame. It takes the photo by itself. If it doesn't, move the phone back a little. Do the front, then the back.
s_selfie
Step two is a quick selfie. Find a well lit place, keep your face in the frame, and remove your hat, glasses or mask.
s_hold
Hold still until you see All set.
s_other
If it says your documents were submitted on another profile, you already have a TAG Markets profile. One person, one profile. Contact your sponsor or TAG Markets support.
s_done
That's it! TAG Markets reviews your documents, and once you're verified, you can make your first deposit.
